# Libria

> Bilingual French/English virtual library for book discovery, editorial notes, external criticism and merchant links.

Canonical site: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/
French book index: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/livres/
English book index: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/books/
French editorial method: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/a-propos/
English editorial method: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/about/
Affiliate disclosure: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/affiliation/ | https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/affiliate-disclosure/
Sitemap: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/sitemap.xml

## Literary wings
- Fantasy: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/fantasy/ | Fantasy: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/fantasy/
- Science-fiction: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/scifi/ | Science fiction: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/scifi/
- Polar: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/polar/ | Crime: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/polar/
- Jeunesse: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/jeunesse/ | Young readers: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/jeunesse/
- Classiques: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/classics/ | Classics: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/classics/
- Romance: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/romance/ | Romance: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/romance/
- Horreur: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/fr/horror/ | Horror: https://trexdbg.github.io/library/en/horror/

## Editorial conventions
- Each book page separates the work summary, Libria's editorial note, external criticism and merchant links.
- External criticism is attributed and linked to its source.
- Affiliate links are explicitly labelled.
- Prefer the canonical individual book page when citing Libria.
